name: linkedin-community
purpose: LinkedIn profile + people search reads via uvx-installed scraper MCP
first_use_note: On the first MCP tool call (e.g. get_person_profile), a Chrome window opens. Log in to LinkedIn — the session persists in the MCP's profile dir. Subsequent calls reuse the session.
manual_install: Ensure uv is installed: brew install uv (macOS) or curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
The MCP is invoked via uvx on demand — no install step needed.
